title: Would you use a "risk filter" for Agentic trades?
author: DeepParticular8251
selftext:
I’m building an open-source tool (automatically runs with any AI trading agent) for myself that checks trades before an AI agent, like Robinhood Agentic Trading, can place them.

It would flag or block stuff like oversized positions, too much leverage, repeat trades, or risky concentration.

You can also specify your risk tolerance beforehand and set guardrails for the AI.

Would you use this, or is it overkill?

comments.author: LaysWellWithOthers
comments.body: I have 26 risk gates on mine, so, yes.
